tools.description: Use this when the user asks 'when is X free', 'how busy is X', or 'which weekend should I try' for ONE named park. tools.name: parksopen_check_alerts
tools.description: Use this when checking current closures, fire bans, advisories, or nearby wildfires for one park or system-wide. Run it before recommending a park in summer; these are 'verify before you travel' notices, never a booking or safety claim.

tools.name: parksopen_check_weather
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about forecast conditions or air quality at a named park. It returns the Environment Canada forecast (daily high/low/conditions, about 6 days) and AQHI for the nearest station; if the park is beyond range it says so and never invents temperatures.

tools.name: parksopen_check_day_passes
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a BC Parks day-use pass is required, available, sold out, not released yet, or closed for a date, park, access area, or AM/PM slot.
